title: HeatSafe Shift
subtitle: A Tamil/English heat-safety plan for outdoor workers, built with the Strands Agents SDK on Amazon Bedrock
closing: Code owns the thresholds and the 108 call. The Strands graph writes the plan, a critic checks it.

scenes.title: A roof job at 1 pm
scenes.caption: A mason types his shift. Code computes the heat index; the planner and critic agents write and check the plan.
scenes.input: I am laying bricks on a roof from 1pm to 5pm today.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "I am laying bricks on a roof from 1pm to 5pm today." --temp 37 --rh 50 --intensity heavy --sun --job construction --lat 9.92 --lon 78.12
scenes.after: Risk EXTREME from the heat index plus heavy work in full sun. Water and rest steps come from OSHA guidance, cited by id.

scenes.title: தலைசுற்றல் (dizziness), in Tamil
scenes.caption: A road worker writes in Tamil and reports warning signs. The plan tells her to stop work and get checked, in Tamil.
scenes.input: இன்று மதியம் சாலை வேலை. எனக்கு தலைசுற்றுகிறது, தலைவலியும் இருக்கு.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "இன்று மதியம் சாலை வேலை. எனக்கு தலைசுற்றுகிறது, தலைவலியும் இருக்கு." --temp 36 --rh 55 --sun --job "road work"
scenes.after: Heat exhaustion signs: stop work, shade, water, clinic today. The 108 rule is still in the plan.

scenes.title: A coworker is confused
scenes.caption: Heat stroke signs. A Strands hook cancels every agent before any model runs, and code sends the 108 instruction.
scenes.input: My coworker is confused and talking nonsense after carrying cement.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "My coworker is confused and talking nonsense after carrying cement." --temp 38 --rh 45 --intensity heavy --job construction --lat 9.92 --lon 78.12
scenes.after: No model can soften this answer: the emergency text is fixed in code and cites NIOSH first aid.
